# Moneybird

Moneybird is an online invoicing and accounting platform designed for small businesses and freelancers, offering features like invoicing, expense tracking, and financial reporting.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/moneybird/.

## Actions

- **Add Note to Contact**: Add a note or to-do to a contact.
- **Archive Contact**: Archive a contact.
- **Create Contact Person**: Create a new contact person.
- **Create Moneybird Contact**: Create a new contact in moneybird.
- **Create Sales Invoice**: Create a new sales invoice.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete a contact.
- **Delete Contact Note**: Delete a note from a contact.
- **Delete Contact Person**: Delete a contact person from a contact.
- **Filter Contacts** (read-only): Filter contacts.
- **Get Additional Charges** (read-only): Get additional charges for a contact.
- **Get Contact** (read-only): Retrieve all information about a specific contact by id.
- **Get Contact by Customer ID** (read-only): Retrieve full contact details by customer id.
- **Get Contact Person** (read-only): Get all information about a contact person.
- **Get Sales Invoice** (read-only): Get a single sales invoice by id.
- **List Administrations** (read-only): List all administrations accessible by the authenticated user.
- **List Contacts Synchronization** (read-only): List all contact ids and versions for synchronization.
- **List Sales Invoices** (read-only): List all sales invoices in an administration.
- **Request Payments Mandate URL**: Request a url for setting up a payments mandate.
- **Update Contact**: Update a contact.
- **Update Contact Person**: Update a contact person.
- **Update Sales Invoice**: Update an existing sales invoice by id.
